$comment: Directory of hosted three.ws Model Context Protocol servers. Every endpoint speaks MCP over Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0, POST). Dozens more install-and-run servers are published on npm under the @three-ws scope; find all of them in the official MCP registry.
name: three.ws
description: The 3D agent economy: generate, rig, and animate 3D avatars and worlds; pay and get paid per call with x402 (USDC on Solana and Base); read live crypto market and on-chain intelligence.

setup.description: One command signs you in (OAuth or API key), writes these servers into Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Hermes, and verifies each with a live tools/list.

servers.name: three.ws
servers.auth: OAuth 2.1 (end-user), API key (server-to-server), or x402 pay-per-call
servers.description: Avatars, glTF/GLB validation and inspection, agent data, memory, and copy-trading tools.

servers.name: 3D Studio
servers.description: Paid text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation, rigging, retexture, and optimization.

servers.name: 3D Studio (free)
servers.description: Free text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigged avatars, persistent talking personas, and a search of the ready-made asset catalog. No account, no payment.

servers.name: Grok
servers.auth: OAuth 2.1 or a connector API key for the account's agent tools; none needed for the free 3D tools
servers.description: One connector URL for Grok Bot and the xAI API: the free 3D studio with agent-ready links and no widgets, plus your agents, their memory and skills once signed in. Never lists a wallet or payment tool.

servers.name: Agent wallet
servers.description: The agent's custodial wallet: check balance, find and pay x402 services, monetize an endpoint.

servers.name: x402 Bazaar
servers.description: Discover, browse, and price paid agent services across the x402 facilitator network.

servers.name: pump.fun
servers.auth: none for the read-only tools; API key or x402 for pumpfun_upload_metadata
servers.description: Free pump.fun and Solana token tools: holders, trades, curve, intel. One write: metadata upload.

servers.name: IBM x402
servers.auth: x402 pay-per-call (authenticated three.ws principals call without per-call payment)

clients.$comment: Per-client setup for the servers above, so an agent can connect three.ws without a human. A three.ws extension that no MCP spec defines: ignore clients and fields you do not recognize. 'server' is always one of servers[].endpoint, 'auth' is one of none, oauth or api-key, and 'settings' holds the exact values for the client's own form or config file. Human version: https://three.ws/connect

claude.name: Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop)
steps: Open the install link, check the name and URL, then click Add. By hand: Customize, Connectors, Add custom connector, paste the URL.
Click Connect and sign in to three.ws. Read the permissions before you approve.
In a chat, open the + menu, then Connectors, and switch three.ws on for that conversation.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
steps: In Settings, Apps & Connectors, Advanced settings, turn on Developer mode.
Back in Apps & Connectors, click Create, enter the settings and create it.
Sign in to three.ws when ChatGPT asks, and approve the permissions.
In a new chat, open the + menu, choose Developer mode, and tick three.ws.

grok-bot.name: Grok Bot
grok-bot.say: Add a custom MCP server called three-ws-grok at https://three.ws/api/mcp-grok

alternatives.use: A free quota of its own that survives reconnects, for scheduled tasks: POST the install endpoint and connect the connector_urls.grok value it returns.
The account's agents, memory and skills. Make a key for an AI agent at the keys page and store it as a Bot secret. A connector key never spends.
The account's agents, memory and skills, signed in once in the browser.

steps: In Grok Bot, open Connectors and add a custom MCP server with the settings above, or send Grok Bot the say sentence and confirm what it shows.
Check the name and URL Grok Bot shows, then confirm.
Ask for 3D in any task, or attach the server with @ and its name.
grok-bot.notes: Grok Bot connects from xAI's cloud, so only a public URL works; never localhost.

cursor.name: Cursor
steps: Open the install link, or add the config to the file.
Cursor runs the three.ws sign-in on first use.

vscode.name: VS Code (GitHub Copilot agent mode)
steps: Open the install link, or add the config to the file.
The server signs you in on first use.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.command: claude mcp add --transport http three-ws-main https://three.ws/api/mcp
steps: In Claude Code, type /mcp, pick three-ws-main and choose Authenticate.
